content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. This is particularly useful for digital creators who want to sell products like ebooks, courses, and templates without incurring the high fees associated with traditional platforms. By utilizing GitHub Pages, you can set up a store that operates independently of payment processors like PayPal and Stripe. This independence is crucial, especially in regions where these platforms are restricted, as it allows you to maintain full ownership of your content and revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a digital product store using GitHub Pages involves several key components working together seamlessly. First, you host your website on GitHub Pages, which is free and allows for easy updates. On the backend, you can integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order processing and delivery automation. Lastly, using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions ensures you only pay a 0.5% fee, compared to the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad. This combination not only reduces costs but also enhances your control over the entire process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment methods fail, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. These creators often sell digital products such as software, presets, and courses, yet struggle with limited access to payment processing tools. By implementing this GitHub Pages-based infrastructure, they can bypass the restrictions posed by traditional platforms and gain full sovereignty over their sales. This approach not only empowers creators but also helps them retain more of their earnings, fostering a more sustainable business model.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, empowering creators to launch without upfront costs.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. GitHub Pages acts as the front end where customers can browse and purchase products. The backend scripts handle tasks like order tracking and product delivery, while NOWPayments allows for seamless crypto transactions. This cohesive architecture ensures that creators can operate a fully functional online store without relying on traditional payment platforms, thus maintaining their revenue and data sovereignty.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store using GitHub Pages, start by creating a GitHub account if you don't have one. Next, set up a new repository for your store and customize it with your product listings. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend functionalities, ensuring your payment processing works smoothly. Sign up for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions and embed the necessary payment buttons. Finally, test your store thoroughly before launching it to ensure everything operates as expected, and you can begin selling your digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to manage your sales independently while keeping more of your profits, as you avoid the high fees associated with traditional payment processors.
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.

Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your digital product store. Customize your repository by adding product listings and descriptions. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend functions like order management. Sign up for NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Test your store to ensure everything works correctly before launching it to the public.

You can utilize GitHub Pages for hosting your ebook and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This combination enables you to sell without the fees associated with traditional platforms.

Yes, by setting up a store on GitHub Pages and using NOWPayments for payment processing, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the advantages of using GitHub Pages for my store?

GitHub Pages is free, allows for easy updates, and gives you full ownership of your content. This makes it an excellent choice for creators looking to sell digital products without platform restrictions.
How do I automate delivery for my digital products?
You can automate delivery by utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools can handle the backend processes to ensure customers receive their products immediately after purchase.
